professional_reference_manager.description: Manager for reference strategy, referee selection, briefing and permission/status tracking.

recruiter_relations_manager.description: Manager for recruiter conversations, recruiter follow-ups, role referrals and search-firm relationships.

recruitment_orchestrator.description: Candidate-side orchestrator for job discovery, career strategy, applications, networking, interviews, offers and job-search operations.

resume_strategist.description: Strategist for overall CV/resume architecture, evidence hierarchy and career narrative.

skills_gap_analyst.description: Analyst for identifying material skill/experience gaps between the candidate and target roles.

target_company_researcher.description: Researcher for target employers, business health, culture signals, teams, current priorities and hiring patterns.
